title: Shipping
body:
Shipping

In the Shipping section for each item in your purchase request, you can change the plant address, need-by date, deliver-to address, or purchase group, if allowed by your organization.

You can make the following shipping information changes during checkout:

  • Edit line item shipping: You can change the shipping information for each line item by doing the following:

    1. In the Shipping section, open the Plant dropdown menu () and click Browse all.

    2. Click New to create a new plant address.

    3. Fill in the address details on the Plant form and click Save.

  • Mass-edit shipping fields: You can change the shipping information for multiple items at once by doing the following:

    1. In the header-level Ship to section, click Manage locations.

    2. You can do the following:

      • Select new values to use on all line items.

      • To use new values on specific line items, click Shipping items to different locations?.

      • To create a new address to use on all line items, do the following:

        1. Open the Plant dropdown menu () and click Browse all.

        2. Click New.

        3. Fill in the address details and click Save.

    3. Click Done to apply the change.

You can also create new ship-to addresses before you checkout. To create ship-to addresses from your user profile, see Creating a Personal Address
